title: Add Wholesale – Voice, a new team and outbound profile
story: Liam in Contoso Sales wants a new phone line called Wholesale – Voice. Calls to that line should go into the existing Order Desk queue so the order team handles wholesale enquiries.
Emma asks for a new owner team in Contoso Sales named Wholesale Ops. She wants at least four people in that team to manage the wholesale workload and reporting.
Raj also wants a new outbound profile called Wholesale Outbound. Outbound calls from that profile should belong to the Order Desk queue so agents log activity against the same queue.
